note: Everything needed to identify the shipped DSperate binary. A fresh clone of this repository plus Docker is the whole toolchain: no sibling checkout, no locally built image, no opaque downloaded binary. The artifact is built by cloning the pinned upstream commit (core.source_url @ core.source_commit) and applying the re-anchored patch series in patches/ (0001-0010) in order; each patch's sha256 is checked before it is applied. The result is identified by artifact.sha256, which is checked rather than trusted. `make standalone` refuses a source archive or artifact whose sha256 does not match this file. The Chinese localization lives in patches 0006-0010.

core.note: v3.0.0 source = the pinned upstream commit (1b76c35) with the patch series in patches/ applied. The v2.1.1 series did not apply to v3.0.0, so it was rebased and re-anchored; the original v2.1.1 patches are kept under standalone/patches-legacy-v2.1.1/ for the audit trail.

build.sdl2: device-provided libSDL2-2.0.so.0, linked dynamically; the MLP1 ships 2.28.5 built with its Wayland video driver
build.wayland_note: The toolchain sysroot's SDL2 2.28.5 is built without its Wayland driver, so its SDL_config.h leaves SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER_WAYLAND undefined and SDL_syswm.h hides SDL_SysWMinfo's Wayland fields. Defining the macro for this build exposes those fields without changing the toolchain, and is what lets the intended dmabuf tier compile. The public union reserves the fields' space regardless, and the binary links the device's Wayland-capable SDL at runtime. The build fails if the probe or display_wl.cpp does not confirm the real tier.
build.source_date_note: The pinned v3.0.0 commit's committer timestamp (1b76c35, 2026-09-26T13:24:50-05:00).
build.cheevos_version_note: Passed explicitly because a shallow checkout's `git describe` fallback is not the one upstream would take; the value is the release tag, which is what DSperate reports to RetroAchievements in its User-Agent.
build.pgo_note: There is no PGO profile for this build and none can be used. Upstream v3.0.0 ships profiles trained by GCC 13.3.0; the MLP1 toolchain is Buildroot GCC 12.3.0, and configure refuses with the fingerprint mismatch (profile 13.3.0 vs this build 2d22e81d...). Re-training would need ROM play sessions on this device and a profile that survives the v3.0.0 source, so the v3.0.0 candidate is a PGO-less build. That is a performance, not a correctness, difference: the emulator runs with -O2 (-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo) and no -fprofile-use. Recorded here rather than silently dropped, because a lock that claims a profile it does not carry is worse than one that says none.

pgo.note: There is no profile behind this artifact. Upstream v3.0.0 ships profiles trained by GCC 13.3.0; this toolchain is Buildroot GCC 12.3.0, so configure stops with a fingerprint mismatch (profile 13.3.0 vs 2d22e81d...) and the build falls back to -DDSPERATE_PGO=off. build_fingerprint is the fingerprint this build's own flags and compiler hash to, which is what a profile would have to match; it is recorded so the gap is visible rather than silent. The v2.1.1 profile this pak itself trained is in history[0].pgo; it does not apply here.

version.note: Locked --version identity. The build exports DSPERATE_LOCK_VERSION and DSPERATE_LOCK_COMMIT, and cmake/version.cmake prefers them over git, so a source archive without git, and a patched checkout git would call dirty, both report v3.0.0 (1b76c35). Without those two the merged tree reports the same tag but the short HEAD hash plus -dirty, because the merge lives in the working tree; the exported pair is what makes the string stable.

history.note: The released v2.1.1 record, kept for the audit trail. That binary is no longer in build/standalone (the v3.0.0 build replaced it) and make standalone can no longer reproduce it either, since the pipeline that trained its PGO profile and applied patches 0001..0012 to the v2.1.1 tree is described by this file as it stood and not by its current state. See PROVENANCE.md.

patches.note: Adds --cache-root-only, --single-rom and --inspect-cart, backed by cart.cache_root_only and cart.single_nds, plus unsafe entry-path rejection. Rebased onto v3.0.0; the cache/archive policy features are still absent upstream, so they are carried. The pak's wrapper pins the extraction cache to its own root, requires exactly one image entry, and sizes the cache before launch.
Keeps checked flush, fsync, close and rename for battery-save and save-state writes. Retains upstream save loading, chip detection and mismatch backups. Rebased onto v3.0.0.

Stops the host-resume lid pulse on a device with no lid switch. The old code fabricated a lid close/open cycle on every resume; the pulse now only fires for a lid already believed closed. Rebased onto v3.0.0.

Makes --version report the lock's tag and commit deterministically via DSPERATE_LOCK_VERSION / DSPERATE_LOCK_COMMIT, so a source archive without git and a patched checkout both report v3.0.0 (1b76c35).

The standalone-ra-account-v1 consumer (Leaf account adapter): shared contract classifier/marker, managed-account bridge with checked token writer, and native login wiring. Captures and scrubs UMRK_RA_ACCOUNT_* at startup; never writes a password or token to a log or argv. Rebased onto v3.0.0.

The CJK face and i18n framework: stb_truetype plus a WenQuanYi Micro Hei subset embedded in font_cn_data.inc, i18n.h, tr_data.inc (zh<->en pairs) and the text layer that routes every code point through it. Built by tools/make_menu_font.py. No UI string is touched by this patch alone. Rebased onto v3.0.0.

The Chinese strings and the switch that selects them, on top of 0006: i18n.h/tr_data.inc plus the literals in menu.cpp/settings.cpp/main.cpp; draw_text and text_width resolve every string through tr_text so one setting flips the whole menu. Adds a UI LANGUAGE / 界面语言 row on OPTIONS (ui.language, persisted, distinct from user.language). Rebased onto v3.0.0.
Wires 0006's face into the drawing path so a Chinese row is readable; text_width and draw_text share step_for. Regenerates font_cn_data.inc against the current strings. Rebased onto v3.0.0.

Sends the rows that format before they translate through tr_text (the format and its values), so English mode stops drawing Chinese and the options page's widest-row measurement is correct. Rebased onto v3.0.0.
The controls-page diamond pips follow the pad's own x/y naming (MLP1 prints x at top, y at left); a pad.xy_naming key plus migration selects the orientation. Rebased onto v3.0.0.

device.checked: 2026-09-15 on an MLP1 running Leaf 0.12.0-beta.1 (LoongOS rootfs; glibc 2.38, SDL 2.28.5, both matching the toolchain sysroot for the core runtime libraries)

artifact.note: Recorded after the build described by this lock: the pinned commit (1b76c35) plus the patch series (0001-0010) applied in order, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH pinned to 1b76c35's committer time, -DDSPERATE_CHEEVOS_VERSION=3.0.0, no PGO, then $CROSS-strip --strip-unneeded, which is what the v2.1.1 pipeline did too and what the device verification requires. The binary embeds the WenQuanYi Micro Hei subset and draws the CJK blocks through it (0006); Latin keeps the 5x7 grid and every row goes through tr_text before it is drawn (0007, 0009); every string the menu can paint is keyed in the language the table resolves, including the achievement status line the account page wraps (0007, 0008); and the face-button pips follow the pad's own naming of x and y (0010). It does not carry a PGO profile (see build.pgo_note) and it was built without Vulkan, because the pinned toolchain image has no vulkan.h: the GPU 3D row is a no-op on this build and the setting says so in Chinese. CI is the independent second-machine verifier; investigate any mismatch rather than overwriting this value.

notice.link: libSDL2-2.0.so.0 and libSDL2_ttf-2.0.so.0, both device-provided; no bundled libraries or fonts
notice.note: The pak's own fullscreen message program. Built in the same pinned image and verified with the same allowlist. Recorded after two clean FORCE=1 builds agree.

localization.check: Against this baseline, the localized v3.0.0 tree draws 248 UI strings, of which 219 are not in the baseline; 213 of those carry Han and the other 6 are one ASCII technical label or a code comment (1X, 60 fps, < %s >, AUTO EMPTY, BIRTHDAY MONTH 11, the slot-row comment). Every string a player can read is covered. The v2.1.1 baseline's fingerprint is b7c405a332fb44694da40a6d38e6b52db6024ca623ccc3dc68737d58bc2d47e0 over 531 entries.
localization.note: The menu's UI text at the pinned commit, as check-upstream-text.py reads it. repack.sh re-reads the same files out of the newest upstream tag and stops with exit 3 on anything the localization does not cover, so a pack never ships a string nobody translated.
